timing_note: Prepared before implementation interface review or execution. This timestamp is approximate; file sealing hash is authoritative for subsequent byte preservation.
scope: CPU-only source-normal payload and explicit loss-report prototype; no native process, receiver mutation, source export or production execution
oracle: Independent struct/json GLB reader and analytic vector cases; no calls to implementation reader, validator or loss math when deriving expected values. Interface adapter may call public prototype API only.

controls.name: Exact accepted payload
controls.expected: Independent GLB byte reader derives all mesh/primitive/triangle/corner/vertex identities and float32 bit patterns; every payload record equals that oracle

controls.name: Exact payload round trip
controls.expected: Serialization and reparse preserve each float32 bit pattern and source/artifact/sidecar binding

controls.name: Shared mesh identity
controls.expected: Reusable mesh references do not cause duplicate or ambiguous source-corner records

controls.name: Signed zero
controls.expected: Independent synthetic GLB includes negative zero; raw float32 sign bit survives round trip

controls.name: Sharp boundary
controls.expected: Two source vertices at the same position with different normals remain separate; matching by position alone cannot pass

controls.name: Exact synthetic observation
controls.expected: Matching directions produce zero component and angular differences; result visibly remains synthetic and supplies no native/shading acceptance

controls.name: Sign inversion
controls.expected: Opposite axis normal has 2.0 component difference and 180-degree angular difference

controls.name: Perpendicular direction
controls.expected: Orthogonal axis normal has 90-degree angular difference

controls.name: Non-unit nonzero observation
controls.expected: Direction comparison treats magnitude explicitly according to the declared contract; normalization must not silently erase component error

controls.name: Missing payload corner
controls.expected: Delete one expected corner: payload validator refuses

controls.name: Duplicate payload corner
controls.expected: Duplicate one corner while retaining count: validator refuses

controls.name: Unknown source corner
controls.expected: Replace an identity with an out-of-range mesh/primitive/triangle/corner: validator refuses

controls.name: Changed winding
controls.expected: Swap triangle indices/corner order while retaining original binding: validator refuses

controls.name: Wrong vertex binding
controls.expected: Change the source vertex for one corner without changing its tuple: validator refuses

controls.name: Source-normal sign alteration
controls.expected: Negate a payload direction without changing authoritative GLB: validator refuses

controls.name: Float32 bit alteration
controls.expected: Alter one least significant bit while preserving a plausible unit vector: validator refuses

controls.name: Nonfinite source vector
controls.expected: NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity in source normals each cause refusal

controls.name: Zero source vector
controls.expected: All-zero source normal causes refusal

controls.name: Stale artifact identity
controls.expected: Correct payload paired with a different GLB hash is refused

controls.name: Stale source identity
controls.expected: Correct GLB paired with wrong accepted source/revision identity is refused

controls.name: Stale sidecar identity
controls.expected: Correct GLB paired with altered semantic sidecar/hash is refused

controls.name: Duplicate observation
controls.expected: Multiple destination observations for one source corner are refused or explicitly invalid; never silently overwritten

controls.name: Missing observation
controls.expected: Missing destination record is reported explicitly and cannot count as a matched/fidelity-passed direction

controls.name: Unknown observation corner
controls.expected: An observation naming an unknown source corner cannot be accepted as valid

controls.name: Nonfinite observation
controls.expected: NaN/Inf destination vectors are explicitly invalid with no finite error or pass claim

controls.name: Zero observation
controls.expected: Zero destination vector is explicitly invalid; undefined angle is not reported as zero

controls.name: Wrong observation binding
controls.expected: Observation with stale GLB/source/sidecar binding is refused

controls.name: Synthetic relabeling
controls.expected: A synthetic CPU fixture cannot be promoted to native receiving evidence by changing a label

controls.name: Noncanonical numeric/identity types
controls.expected: Booleans in numeric identity fields and malformed float32 values cannot be silently coerced into valid records

controls.name: GLB accessor bounds
controls.expected: Truncated/out-of-range normal/index buffer data is refused before producing a partial payload

controls.name: Malformed source references
controls.expected: Absent normals, unsupported primitive mode, out-of-range indices and sparse/unsupported layout have explicit refusal behavior
